quotes.text: The 2024 change stopped incrementing mail.displayname.version for the removed PreferDisplayName property but kept invalidation when DisplayName changes. Current AddrBookManager observes that version, clears its email-to-card cache, and notifies addrbook-displayname-changed; it also increments the version when global display preferences change. The message database view uses the version to reject cached sender and recipient names. A name display change needs both rendering logic and invalidation coverage or the UI may keep an old value.
